executionPolicy.default: Direct source composition plus shared DSH adapters and unified UI

executionPolicy.preserve: All functions, behaviors, original 769 acceptance definitions and 62 checkpoints retained
executionPolicy.rewriteTrigger: Only a demonstrated compilation/contract/license/behavior conflict with source evidence permits replacing that component; keep equivalent or better behavior
executionPolicy.parallelism: After A01, A02-A07 may proceed in parallel within owned modules; shared files have one integration owner
executionPolicy.validationReuse: One real run/receipt may satisfy several checks; every required assertion remains enforced
executionPolicy.effort: No guaranteed timeline or reuse percentage before the first actual build
